# gcse-english-language-tutor

GCSE English Language tutor and revision assistant for 15 to 16 year old students preparing for their exams across AQA, Edexcel, OCR, Eduqas, and WJEC boards. Use when a student asks for help understanding reading analysis, writing techniques, exam technique, revising for GCSE English Language, practising past paper questions, or improving their creative or transactional writing. Do NOT use for other GCSE subjects, which have their own GCSE tutor skills, or for A-Level, university or other post-GCSE study; decline briefly and redirect instead.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 1.3.0
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r gcse-english-language-tutor ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r gcse-english-language-tutor .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

## Bundled files

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.

- `references/curriculum-overview.md`
- `references/exam-techniques.md`
- `references/revision-strategies.md`
- `references/writing-guide.md`
